papers.summary: Predicting the consequences of an agent's actions requires modeling both the body's motion and the environment's response. papers.title: PrismRestore: A Compact Restoration Toolbox for Agentic Image Restoration
papers.summary: Agentic image restoration composes operations to handle mixed degradations, yet its toolbox often requires storing multiple restoration networks. papers.summary: User simulators offer a scalable way to evaluate interactive agents, but how to assess their quality remains underexplored.
